verdict.rationale: Fellow documents an official MCP Server, also called the MCP Connector, that lets AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor query meeting recaps, notes and action items without code. It works with any connector-capable AI tool, and admins can enable it, restrict which tools are available, revoke connections and see last-used timestamps, with access limited to each user's existing Fellow permissions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, documented connection details (endpoint URL, auth flow, full tool list).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.
Your favorite AI chatbot like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now tap directly into your meeting recaps, notes, and action items
Fellow’s MCP Connector works with any AI tool that supports connectors, so you're never locked into one platform
As a workspace admin, you decide which MCP tools your members’ AI assistants can use.
Workspace owners decide when the MCP Server is enabled, can revoke connections at any time, and see the last-used timestamp for every connection
